name: Kinshasa
subtitle: Kinshasa, capital of the Democratic Republic of the Congo: its numbers, a short history and places to see beyond the World Heritage list.

keyPoints.text: The 210-metre Tour de l'Échangeur and the new National Museum celebrate the monumental scale and artistic heritage of the Congo basin.

gaps: No comprehensive nationwide census has been held in the DRC since 1984; modern demographic projections vary significantly.
First-hand local voices from artists at the Académie des Beaux-Arts and Kinois musicians are still missing.
Some statements were removed on 15 November 2026 because the page cited for them did not contain the quoted words in an automatic check.
